messages:
Maya: heads-up — onboarding meta-mix-small-v2 into RW staging. seeing sporadic tool-call JSON corruption in the eval harness (parse errors ~7%).
Sam: what does the raw model output look like when it breaks?
Maya: usually truncated or contains role markers inside the JSON. e.g.
Maya: ```
assistant: {"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "redwood inference"}
```
Maya: note the missing closing brace and occasionally a `<|assistant|>` token appears mid-json.
Jordan: two likely causes: (1) tokenizer special tokens not registered or split by BPE, (2) model chat template that injects role markers without spacing so tokens merge.
Priya: also check model config — some HF configs have add_bos_token or weird pad/eos defaults. that shifts token ids if not normalized.
Sam: on conversion we try to map HF special tokens -> RW sentinels. but if the sentinel isn't a single token (tokenizer splits it), sampling noise can produce partial sentinel fragments.
Maya: the meta-mix tokenizer had bespoke sentinels `<|json_begin|>` / `<|json_end|>` but they weren't present in the tokenizer special list, so they were BPE-split.
Maya: quantizing to 4-bit exacerbated it — sampling produced the split fragment `<|json_st` sometimes.
Jordan: classic sentinel-boundary collision. mitigation options: register specials, pick unicode-rare internal sentinels, and assert single-token property in preflight.
Sam: patch we used (conversion snippet):
Sam: ```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
T = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(src)
specials = ['<|json_begin|>', '<|json_end|>', '<|tool_open|>', '<|tool_close|>']
# add only if needed
new = [s for s in specials if s not in T.get_vocab()]
if new:
    T.add_special_tokens({'additional_special_tokens': new})
T.bos_token = '<s>'
T.eos_token = '</s>'
T.save_pretrained(dest)
# emit mapping for runtime lookup
with open(dest + '/rw_token_ids.txt', 'w') as f:
    for s in specials:
        f.write(f"{s}:{T.convert_tokens_to_ids(s)}\\n")
```
Maya: after adding specials + saving tokenizer, 2k-run tool-call evals dropped parse errors 7% -> 0.9%.
Priya: any quality regressions after 4-bit? quantization tends to nudge length preference.
Maya: small hit on our tooling traces (BLEU-like drop ~0.6). we forced temp=0.0 for tool-call tasks and got deterministic JSONs back.
Sam: watch out for HF chat templates with role tags glued to text (e.g. `<|assistant|>Hello`). RW expects a space after role token. we added a normalization step: `prompt = re.sub(r'<\\|assistant\\|>(\\S)', '<|assistant|> \\1', prompt)` before tokenization.
Jordan: also found invisible control chars — a model's special token list had zero-width non-joiners. they can silently split or be stripped by downstream logging.
Priya: suggestion: add a preflight convert check: for each sentinel `s`, assert `len(tokenizer.tokenize(s)) == 1`. if not, either add as special or choose alternate sentinel.
Sam: Agreed. Implemented `preflight --sanity` that prints tokenization counts for required sentinels and fails conversion if not OK unless `--force`.
Maya: added token-level failure dumps into runtime to aid debugging. example dump before fixes: 
Maya: ```
# token window around parse error: [101, 5023, 32005, 17, 9]
# decode window -> 'search', ' ', '<', '|json_beg'  (sentinel split)
```
Jordan: excellent. action items: Maya to PR conversion + preflight check; Jordan to add token-id dump and enhanced parser logging; Priya to add a quick quantize smoke test that includes sentinel integrity checks.
Sam: also doc note for onboarding: pick sentinels not present in training data or BPE merges; prefer a single-token sentinel and avoid plain ascii sequences common in text.
infra-bot: conversion patch deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
evals-bot: tool-call regression-suite -> pass (99.1% parse success)
Maya: thanks all, I'll follow up with the PR link and verify prod rollout window. :party:
